mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.board_id, p.title, p.content, p.like_count, p.created_at, p.updated_at, u.id AS author_id, u.username AS author_username, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar FROM post p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE p.board_id = #{boardId} AND p.status = 0 ORDER BY p.id DESC
